text:
**Seri Everbright Klinik Sdn. Bhd.** (Reg: SYN-000783) is an active private limited company incorporated in December 1995, based in Kedah, Malaysia. Operating in the healthcare sector, the company specializes in in-home elderly care services (*perkhidmatan jagaan warga emas di rumah*). 

**Ownership & Governance:**
* **Managing Director & 100% Shareholder:** Director 1 (appointed Dec 2021)
* **Independent Director:** Director 2 (appointed May 2003)

**Financial Performance (FY2022–FY2024):**
* **Revenue:** Grew steadily from RM43.9M (2022) to RM48.3M (2023) and reached RM58.0M in 2024.
* **Profitability:** Recovered from net losses in FY2022 (RM-5.45M) and FY2023 (RM-1.51M) to post a net profit of RM3.85M in FY2024 (net margin 6.64%).
* **Cash Flow:** Operating cash flow turned positive at RM1.20M in 2023 and strengthened to RM6.12M in 2024.

**Legal:** 
One past debt recovery case (filed as plaintiff in Nov 2022) was dismissed. All three years feature unqualified audit opinions.
